title: Sweet Australian Kissed Potato Bake
description: A delicious and easy-to-make potato dish with a sweet twist.
instructions: Wash and slice the sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with kissed olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Transfer the sweet potatoes to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Dot the top of the sweet potatoes with molten butter.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and caramelized.
